description: This file contains unit tests for the SecurePrefs class related to notification forwarding quiet hours, using Robolectric framework for Android testing.

classes.name: SecurePrefsNotificationForwardingTest
classes.description: Test class for SecurePrefs notification forwarding quiet hours features.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours_rejectsInvalidDraftsWithoutMutatingStoredValues
methods.description: Tests that invalid quiet hours drafts are rejected and do not alter stored preferences.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours_persistsValidDraftsAndEnabledState
methods.description: Tests that valid quiet hours settings are persisted correctly.

methods.name: setNotificationForwardingQuietHours_disablesWithoutRevalidatingDrafts
methods.description: Tests that disabling notification forwarding does not revalidate or alter existing drafts unnecessarily.

methods.name: getNotificationForwardingPolicy_readsLatestQuietHoursImmediately
methods.description: Tests that the notification forwarding policy reflects the latest quiet hours immediately after setting.

methods.name: notificationForwarding_defaultsDisabledForSaferPosture
methods.description: Checks default state of notification forwarding is disabled for safer device posture.
